about.description: OpenDelta is an onchain asset management and issuance platform that lets asset managers, fintechs, and treasuries create and distribute tokenized financial products. Its flagship listed product is NX8, a tokenized index of eight major layer 1 network tokens built with Nansen, with methodology by GMCI, custody by Anchorage and Hex Trust, and reserve verification by Accountable.
about.registryInfo: OpenDelta - modular onchain asset management framework providing tokenization, operations, issuance, and distribution rails for crypto-native asset managers. NX8 ecosystem partner: Nansen. Methodology provider: GMCI. SPL token on Solana, LayerZero OFT-compatible across additional chains. Underlying basket assets held in custody by OpenDelta infrastructure partners.
